Both `header.json` and `units-001.json` have been updated against HEAD `4872083c0` and accepted:

1. **`header.json`**: Kept unchanged (`accepted header.json: 4 conventions, 2 file checks, 1 project checks`).
2. **`units-001.json`**:
   - **`U01`, `U03`, `U04`, `U05`**: Re-anchored all sites and line ranges to the reverted HEAD files (`colors.test.ts`, `colors.ts`, `EyeDropper.tsx`, `CHANGELOG.md`) while keeping their Gate 2 revision 1 behaviour, rules, tests, checks, red_checks, covers, uses, and `depends_on` unchanged.
   - **`U02` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/eyeDropper.test.tsx`)**: Restored the full Gate 2 revision 1 reproducing tests and rules plus the `beforeEach(() => { editorJotaiStore.set(activeEyeDropperAtom, null); })` reset and `activeEyeDropperAtom` / `editorJotaiStore` imports, anchored against HEAD's 50-line file (`S1`: replace lines 1–6; `S2`: `insert_after` line 8; `S3`: `insert_after` line 49).
